# CANDIDATE: VANNA_EXPOSURE_SPIKE_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extreme positive Vanna exposure indicates dealer gamma hedging pressure that creates intraday resistance, favoring short positions on rallies. This edge exists because market makers delta-hedge their short gamma positions by selling into strength when Vanna (delta sensitivity to volatility) is high, creating temporary supply zones that reject price advances.

## Mechanism

Entry: Vanna exposure (0DTE SPY) > 2σ above its 20-day average, price forms bearish bar (close < open) with long upper wick (>60% of bar's range) at intraday high, volume > 20-day average volume, 5EMA < 8EMA (bearish ribbon), time between 10:30-15:00 EST. Exit: chart-stop at entry bar high, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed 10% below highest-watermark. Regime filter: VIX > 18 and time 10:30-15:00 EST (already embedded in entry time window).
